basics.name: Chenyi Jiang / 江宸逸
basics.summary: Ph.D. candidate at Nanjing University of Science and Technology studying visual-semantic generalization beyond the training distribution, with a focus on compositional and generalized zero-shot recognition.

education.institution: Nanjing University of Science and Technology
Nanjing University of Science and Technology

publications.name: Learning Clique-Based Inter-Class Affinity for Compositional Zero-Shot Learning
publications.summary: Builds multi-level semantic and visual affinity cliques for hierarchical one-to-many alignment.

publications.name: Imbuing, Enrichment and Calibration: Leveraging Language for Unseen Domain Extension
publications.summary: Extends a model to an unseen domain with language-conditioned styles, local variation, and calibrated semantic dimensions.

publications.name: Imaginary-Connected Embedding in Complex Space for Unseen Attribute-Object Discrimination
publications.publisher: IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence, 2025
publications.summary: Uses complex-space embeddings in which phase models attribute-object dependence while primitives remain independently acquired.

publications.name: Mutual Balancing in State-Object Components for Compositional Zero-Shot Learning
publications.summary: Treats compositional zero-shot learning as unbalanced multi-label classification and rebalances decision boundaries.

publications.name: Estimation of Near-Instance-Level Attribute Bottleneck for Zero-Shot Learning
publications.summary: Replaces class-level attributes with near-instance-level basis vectors and region-aware visual-attribute relations.

publications.name: Revealing the Proximate Long-Tail Distribution in Compositional Zero-Shot Learning
publications.summary: Derives a class-prior correction for composition-induced visual bias without adding inference parameters.

publications.name: Evolutionary Generalized Zero-Shot Learning
publications.publisher: International Joint Conference on Artificial Intelligence, 2024
publications.summary: Co-authored work framing generalized zero-shot learning as an evolutionary process over the seen/unseen boundary.

publications.name: Fusing Spatial and Frequency Features for Compositional Zero-Shot Image Classification
publications.summary: Co-authored work combining spatial-domain and frequency-domain representations.

publications.name: Do They Share the Same Tail? Learning Individual Compositional Attribute Prototype for Generalized Zero-Shot Learning
publications.summary: Co-authored work learning individualized compositional attribute prototypes.

publications.name: Learning to Calibrate Prototypes for Few-Shot Image Classification
publications.summary: Co-authored work calibrating class prototypes to reduce estimation bias under few-shot supervision.

publications.name: Contextual Interaction via Primitive-Based Adversarial Training for Compositional Zero-Shot Learning
publications.summary: Co-authored work modeling contextual interaction between states and objects with primitive-level adversarial training.

publications.name: Multi-Domain Feature-Enhanced Attribute Updater for Generalized Zero-Shot Learning
publications.summary: Co-authored work enhancing attribute representations across multiple feature domains.

publications.name: Text-Vision Fusion and Semantic Adaptive Labeling for Compositional Zero-Shot Learning
publications.summary: Co-authored work fusing textual and visual cues with adaptive semantic labeling.

publications.name: Language-Guided Attribute Alignment and Semantic Consistency for Zero-Shot Domain Adaptation
publications.publisher: IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation, 2026
publications.summary: Co-authored work on language-guided attribute alignment and semantic consistency for zero-shot domain adaptation.
